notes: Dating: all eight episodes (392-399) confirm the weekly estimates from audio cues with no gaps: 392 = 28 Av 5749 (1989-08-29, Rosh Chodesh Elul Thursday); 393 = first week of Elul (1989-09-05); 394 = 1989-09-12 ('next Monday the 18th of September is Chai Elul'); 395 = day after Chai Elul (1989-09-19, first Selichos that Motzei Shabbos); 396 = 1989-09-26 (Erev Rosh Hashanah on Friday, Tzemach Tzedek's 200th birthday); 397 = 4 Tishrei 5750 (1989-10-03, Vov Tishrei Thursday, Shabbos Shuvah); 398 = 11 Tishrei (1989-10-10, Erev Sukkos Friday 13 Oct); 399 = Chol HaMoed Sukkos (1989-10-17).

Identity clue: in episode 397 (084989493e) a Shema guest from a shlichus family in Madrid calls the host 'Zaidy' and he says she is his granddaughter; her surname is Goldstein. The episode 392 Shema guest is also named Goldstein (Ohalei Torah), possibly family. Recorded only in hidden.
